allowEmpty.zh-CN: 值变为空的字段是否在 values 中保留 key。Form 与字段任一设置为 true 即生效。
allowEmpty.en-US: Whether a field whose value becomes empty keeps its key in values. Setting it to true on either the Form or the field takes effect.

autoScrollToError.zh-CN: 提交或调用 formApi.validate 校验失败时，是否自动滚动到出错的字段；传对象时作为 scroll-into-view-if-needed 的选项。
autoScrollToError.en-US: Whether to scroll to the first invalid field when submit or formApi.validate fails. An object is passed to scroll-into-view-if-needed as its options.

children.zh-CN: 表单内容。传入函数时与 render 一样只调用一次，参数为 `{ formState, values, formApi }`，需在返回的 JSX 中读取它们，才会随表单更新。
children.en-US: The content of the form. A function is called once, like render, with `{ formState, values, formApi }`; read them in the returned JSX to follow the form.

component.zh-CN: 用于声明表单控件的组件，以 formState、values、formApi 作为 props 渲染；不可与 render、children 同时使用。
component.en-US: A component that declares the fields, rendered with formState, values and formApi as its props. Do not use it together with render or children.

disabled.zh-CN: 统一应用在每个字段上的 disabled，字段自身的 disabled 优先。
disabled.en-US: The disabled state applied to every field. A field's own disabled takes precedence.

extraTextPosition.zh-CN: 统一应用在每个字段上的 extraText 位置，middle 在 Label 与控件之间，bottom 在控件之后。字段上的同名属性优先。
extraTextPosition.en-US: Position of the extra text of every field: middle puts it between the label and the control, bottom after the control. The same property on a field takes precedence.

form.zh-CN: `useForm()` 返回的 formApi，用于在 Form 外部控制表单。
form.en-US: The formApi returned by `useForm()`, used to control the form from outside.

getFormApi.zh-CN: Form 挂载后调用，参数为 formApi。
getFormApi.en-US: Called once the Form has mounted, with the formApi.

id.zh-CN: form 元素的 id，同时写入 x-form-id；不传时自动生成。
id.en-US: The id of the form element, also written to x-form-id. Generated when omitted.

initValues.zh-CN: 表单的初始值，仅在 Form 创建时复制一次。
initValues.en-US: Initial values of the form, copied once when the Form is created.

keepState.zh-CN: 字段卸载后是否保留它的值、错误和 touched，重新挂载时按路径恢复。字段、ArrayField 未设置时取这里的值。
keepState.en-US: Whether an unmounted field keeps its value, error and touched state, restored by path when it mounts again. Fields and ArrayFields without their own setting use this value.

labelAlign.zh-CN: 统一应用在每个字段上的 label 文本对齐方式，字段上的同名属性优先。
labelAlign.en-US: Text alignment of the label of every field. The same property on a field takes precedence.

labelCol.zh-CN: 统一应用在每个字段上的 label 栅格布局，同 Col 的 span、offset 等属性，需与 wrapperCol 一起设置。
labelCol.en-US: Grid layout of the label of every field, with the properties of Col such as span and offset. Set it together with wrapperCol.

labelPosition.zh-CN: 统一应用在每个字段上的 label 位置，inset 仅部分字段支持，其余字段按 top 布局。字段上的同名属性优先。
labelPosition.en-US: Label position of every field. inset is supported by some fields only; the others are laid out as top. The same property on a field takes precedence.

labelWidth.zh-CN: 统一应用在每个字段上的 label 宽度，数字单位为 px。
labelWidth.en-US: Label width of every field. A number is in px.

layout.zh-CN: 字段的排列方向，可选 vertical 或 horizontal。
layout.en-US: Direction in which the fields are arranged: vertical or horizontal.

onChange.zh-CN: 表单状态更新时调用，包括字段挂载、卸载、值变更、blur、校验状态与错误信息变更，参数为 formState。
onChange.en-US: Called when the form state changes: a field mounts, unmounts, changes its value, blurs, or changes its validation state or error. Receives formState.

onErrorChange.zh-CN: 校验状态更新时调用，参数为全部错误和本次变化的字段错误。validate、submit、reset 等批量操作只调用一次，静默校验不调用。
onErrorChange.en-US: Called when validation state changes, with all errors and the errors that changed. Batch operations such as validate, submit and reset call it once; silent validation does not.

onReset.zh-CN: 点击重置按钮或调用 formApi.reset 时调用。
onReset.en-US: Called when a reset button is clicked or formApi.reset is called.

onSubmit.zh-CN: 点击提交按钮或调用 formApi.submitForm 且校验通过后调用，参数为 values 与提交事件；配置了 `schema` 时 values 是 schema 的输出。
onSubmit.en-US: Called when a submit button is clicked or formApi.submitForm is called and validation passes, with values and the submit event. With `schema`, values are the schema's output.

onSubmitFail.zh-CN: 点击提交按钮或调用 formApi.submitForm 且校验失败后调用，参数为 errors、values 与提交事件。errors 的每个错误是字符串数组；校验函数抛出的异常原样传入。
onSubmitFail.en-US: Called when a submit button is clicked or formApi.submitForm is called and validation fails, with errors, values and the submit event. Each error in errors is a string array; an exception thrown by a validator is passed as is.

onValueChange.zh-CN: 字段的值变化时调用，参数为全部 values 与本次变化的字段值。
onValueChange.en-US: Called when a field value changes, with all values and the values that changed.

ref.zh-CN: 取得 form 元素的回调，元素上带有 formApi。
ref.en-US: Receives the form element, which carries the formApi.

render.zh-CN: 用于声明表单控件的函数，只调用一次，参数为 `{ formState, values, formApi }`；不可与 component、children 同时使用。
render.en-US: A function that declares the fields. It is called once, with `{ formState, values, formApi }`. Do not use it together with component or children.

showValidateIcon.zh-CN: 校验信息前是否显示对应状态的图标。
showValidateIcon.en-US: Whether the validation message is preceded by an icon of its status.

stopPropagation.zh-CN: 是否阻止 submit、reset 事件冒泡，用于嵌套 Form 时避免触发外层 Form 的事件。
stopPropagation.en-US: Whether to stop the submit and reset events from bubbling, so that a nested Form does not trigger the events of the outer one.

stopValidateWithError.zh-CN: 使用 rules 校验时，遇到第一条不通过的规则后是否不再校验后续规则。字段上的同名属性优先。
stopValidateWithError.en-US: Whether to skip the remaining rules after the first rule fails. The same property on a field takes precedence.

trigger.zh-CN: 统一应用在每个字段上的校验时机，可选 change、blur、mount、custom 或其数组。字段上的同名属性优先。
trigger.en-US: When every field validates: change, blur, mount, custom, or an array of them. The same property on a field takes precedence.

schemaDebounce.zh-CN: 配置了 `schema` 时，值变化触发的校验在输入停顿多少毫秒后才运行；submit、formApi.validate 与 blur 触发的校验不等待。
schemaDebounce.en-US: With `schema`, how many milliseconds of pause in input a change-triggered validation waits for. Validation on submit, formApi.validate and blur does not wait.

schema.zh-CN: 实现了 Standard Schema 的校验对象（如 Zod、Valibot、ArkType），与字段的 validator、rules 互斥，设置后它们不再运行。校验全部字段通过后，`onSubmit` 与 formApi.validate 拿到 schema 的输出。同时传 `validator` 时只用 `validator`。
schema.en-US: A Standard Schema object (Zod, Valibot, ArkType and so on), mutually exclusive with the validator and rules of the fields, which no longer run. Once all fields pass, `onSubmit` and formApi.validate receive the schema's output. When `validator` is also set, only `validator` applies.

validator.zh-CN: Form 级别的校验函数，submit 与 formApi.validate 时调用，支持返回 Promise，与 `schema` 互斥。设置后字段自身的 validator 与 rules 不再生效。返回空值或空对象表示通过，失败时返回与 values 结构相同的错误对象，每个错误是字符串或字符串数组。
validator.en-US: Form-level validation, called on submit and formApi.validate and allowed to return a Promise. It excludes `schema`. When set, the validator and rules of the fields no longer apply. An empty value or object means valid; on failure return an error object shaped like the values, each error a string or a string array.

wrapperCol.zh-CN: 统一应用在每个字段上的控件栅格布局，同 Col 的 span、offset 等属性，需与 labelCol 一起设置。
wrapperCol.en-US: Grid layout of the control of every field, with the properties of Col such as span and offset. Set it together with labelCol.

children.zh-CN: 每一行的渲染函数，必填，只调用一次，参数为 `{ arrayFields, add, addWithInitValue, move }`，需在返回的 JSX 中读取 `arrayFields` 才会随行增删更新。`move(from, to)` 把一行连同它的值、错误和 touched 移到目标位置，越界的下标按首尾处理。
children.en-US: Required. A function that renders the rows. It is called once, with `{ arrayFields, add, addWithInitValue, move }`; read `arrayFields` in the returned JSX to follow the rows. `move(from, to)` moves a row with its values, errors and touched state, clamping indexes out of range.

field.zh-CN: 数组在 formState.values 中的路径，必填。例如各行字段为 a[0].name、a[1].name 时应传 a。
field.en-US: Required. Path of the array in formState.values. For rows with fields a[0].name and a[1].name pass a.

initValue.zh-CN: 数组的初始值，必须是数组；与 Form 的 initValues 同时配置时优先。
initValue.en-US: Initial value of the array, which must be an array. It takes precedence over the initValues of the Form.

keepState.zh-CN: 卸载时是否保留整组数据，也是行内字段未设置 keepState 时的默认值；未设置时取 Form 的 keepState。保留时重新挂载按保留的值渲染各行。
keepState.en-US: Whether the whole array keeps its data when unmounted, and the default keepState of the fields in its rows. Defaults to the Form's keepState. When kept, the rows render from the kept values on remount.

text.zh-CN: 分组标题，没有内容时不渲染标题。
text.en-US: The title of the section. No title is rendered when it has no content.

align.zh-CN: Label 文本的对齐方式，可选 left 或 right。
align.en-US: Text alignment of the label: left or right.

extra.zh-CN: 跟随在 label 文本后的内容。

name.zh-CN: 所标注控件的 id，写入 label 的 for 属性；不传时使用 `for`。
name.en-US: The id of the labeled control, written to the for attribute. `for` is used when it is not set.

optional.zh-CN: 是否在文本后追加语言包中的可选标识。为 true 时不再显示 required 的 *。
optional.en-US: Whether to append the optional text of the locale. When true, the * of required is hidden.

required.zh-CN: 是否显示必填的 * 号。
required.en-US: Whether to display the required * symbol.

text.zh-CN: Label 文本；不传时使用 children。
text.en-US: Text of the label. children is used when it is not set.

width.zh-CN: Label 宽度，数字单位为 px。
width.en-US: Width of the label. A number is in px.

disabled.zh-CN: 组内字段统一的 disabled，不传时沿用 Form 的 disabled。
disabled.en-US: The disabled state applied to the fields in the group. Falls back to the Form's disabled when not set.

extraText.zh-CN: 额外的提示信息，位置由 extraTextPosition 决定。
extraText.en-US: Extra text of the group, positioned by extraTextPosition.

extraTextPosition.zh-CN: extraText 的位置，middle 在 Label 与 Group 之间，bottom 在 Group 之后，默认为 bottom。
extraTextPosition.en-US: Position of the extra text: middle puts it between the label and the group, bottom after the group. Defaults to bottom.

label.zh-CN: 整个 Group 的 Label：对象作为 Label 配置，其中 id 用作 Label 的 id，其他内容作为 Label 文本。
label.en-US: Label of the whole group: an object is the label configuration, whose id becomes the id of the label, and any other content is the label text.

labelPosition.zh-CN: Label 的位置，默认取自 Form，可选 top 或 left。
labelPosition.en-US: Label position. Defaults to the Form's, and can be top or left.

onBlur.zh-CN: 焦点离开组内任一控件时调用，在组内控件之间移动焦点时也会调用。
onBlur.en-US: Called as focus leaves any control in the group, also for a move to another control in it.

onFocus.zh-CN: 组内任一控件获得焦点时调用，从组内另一控件移入时也会调用。
onFocus.en-US: Called as any control in the group takes focus, also for a move from another control in it.

size.zh-CN: 组内所有控件的尺寸，可选 small、default 或 large。
size.en-US: Size of every control in the group: small, default or large.

error.zh-CN: 错误信息，渲染在内容之后：对象作为 ErrorMessage 的属性，字符串或字符串数组作为错误内容；不传则不显示。
error.en-US: The error, rendered after the content: an object is the props of ErrorMessage, and a string or string array is the error. Nothing shows when omitted.

label.zh-CN: Label 的文本，或 text、extra、align、width、required、optional 等 Label 配置。
label.en-US: The text of the label, or a label configuration such as text, extra, align, width, required and optional.

labelPosition.zh-CN: Label 的位置，默认取自 Form，可选 top 或 left。
labelPosition.en-US: Label position. Defaults to the Form's, and can be top or left.

noLabel.zh-CN: 是否不渲染 Label；Form 同时设置了 labelCol 与 wrapperCol 时，Label 列仍保留。
noLabel.en-US: Whether to render no label. When the Form sets both labelCol and wrapperCol, the label column is still kept.

error.zh-CN: 错误信息，字符串数组，多条以逗号连接显示。有错误时不显示 helpText；`['']` 表示校验失败但没有文本，不渲染内容；空数组与空值视为没有错误。
error.en-US: The error, a string array whose messages are joined with commas. helpText is hidden while there is an error; `['']` means failed without text and renders nothing; an empty array or empty value means no error.

helpText.zh-CN: 提示信息，与错误信息共用同一区块，两者都有时显示错误信息。
helpText.en-US: The help text. It shares the block with the error, and the error is shown when both are set.

showValidateIcon.zh-CN: 是否显示 validateStatus 对应的图标。
showValidateIcon.en-US: Whether to show the icon of validateStatus.

validateStatus.zh-CN: 信息所属的校验状态，可选 default、error、warning、success。
validateStatus.en-US: Validation status of the message: default, error, warning or success.

field.zh-CN: 要渲染的节点路径，默认为根；根对象不包 Section，其他对象渲染为以 title 为标题的 Section。
field.en-US: Path of the node to render, the root by default. The root object renders without a Section; other objects render as a Section titled by their title.

jsonSchema.zh-CN: 要渲染的 JSON Schema，优先于从 Form 的 `schema` 导出的 JSON Schema；两者都没有时不渲染，开发模式下警告。
jsonSchema.en-US: The JSON Schema to render. It takes precedence over the JSON Schema exported from the Form's `schema`; with neither, nothing renders and a warning is logged in development.

renderField.zh-CN: 按节点路径接管渲染，数组的行写作 `[]`（如 `contacts[].email`），参数为 `{ node, field }`；命中时由它渲染这个节点和它的子节点。
renderField.en-US: Renderers by node path, with array rows written as `[]` (such as `contacts[].email`), called with `{ node, field }`. A match renders the node and its subtree.

widgets.zh-CN: 替换内置控件的字段组件，键是 JSON Schema 的 `format` 或控件种类（input、textarea、number、switch、select），先按 `format` 再按种类查找；组件收到与内置控件相同的属性。
widgets.en-US: Field components in place of the built-in controls, keyed by the JSON Schema `format` or by kind (input, textarea, number, switch, select), looked up by `format` first. A component receives the props of the built-in control.

allowEmpty.zh-CN: 值变为空的字段是否在 values 中保留 key。Form 与字段任一设置为 true 即生效。
allowEmpty.en-US: Whether a field whose value becomes empty keeps its key in values. Setting it to true on either the Form or the field takes effect.

autoScrollToError.zh-CN: 提交或调用 formApi.validate 校验失败时，是否自动滚动到出错的字段；传对象时作为 scroll-into-view-if-needed 的选项。
autoScrollToError.en-US: Whether to scroll to the first invalid field when submit or formApi.validate fails. An object is passed to scroll-into-view-if-needed as its options.

children.zh-CN: 渲染在字段之后的内容，适合放提交按钮。
children.en-US: Content rendered after the fields, such as a submit button.

disabled.zh-CN: 统一应用在每个字段上的 disabled，字段自身的 disabled 优先。
disabled.en-US: The disabled state applied to every field. A field's own disabled takes precedence.

extraTextPosition.zh-CN: 统一应用在每个字段上的 extraText 位置，middle 在 Label 与控件之间，bottom 在控件之后。字段上的同名属性优先。
extraTextPosition.en-US: Position of the extra text of every field: middle puts it between the label and the control, bottom after the control. The same property on a field takes precedence.

form.zh-CN: `useForm()` 返回的 formApi，用于在 Form 外部控制表单。
form.en-US: The formApi returned by `useForm()`, used to control the form from outside.

getFormApi.zh-CN: Form 挂载后调用，参数为 formApi。
getFormApi.en-US: Called once the Form has mounted, with the formApi.

id.zh-CN: form 元素的 id，同时写入 x-form-id；不传时自动生成。
id.en-US: The id of the form element, also written to x-form-id. Generated when omitted.

initValues.zh-CN: 表单的初始值，仅在 Form 创建时复制一次。
initValues.en-US: Initial values of the form, copied once when the Form is created.

keepState.zh-CN: 字段卸载后是否保留它的值、错误和 touched，重新挂载时按路径恢复。字段、ArrayField 未设置时取这里的值。
keepState.en-US: Whether an unmounted field keeps its value, error and touched state, restored by path when it mounts again. Fields and ArrayFields without their own setting use this value.

labelAlign.zh-CN: 统一应用在每个字段上的 label 文本对齐方式，字段上的同名属性优先。
labelAlign.en-US: Text alignment of the label of every field. The same property on a field takes precedence.

labelCol.zh-CN: 统一应用在每个字段上的 label 栅格布局，同 Col 的 span、offset 等属性，需与 wrapperCol 一起设置。
labelCol.en-US: Grid layout of the label of every field, with the properties of Col such as span and offset. Set it together with wrapperCol.

labelPosition.zh-CN: 统一应用在每个字段上的 label 位置，inset 仅部分字段支持，其余字段按 top 布局。字段上的同名属性优先。
labelPosition.en-US: Label position of every field. inset is supported by some fields only; the others are laid out as top. The same property on a field takes precedence.

labelWidth.zh-CN: 统一应用在每个字段上的 label 宽度，数字单位为 px。
labelWidth.en-US: Label width of every field. A number is in px.

layout.zh-CN: 字段的排列方向，可选 vertical 或 horizontal。
layout.en-US: Direction in which the fields are arranged: vertical or horizontal.

onChange.zh-CN: 表单状态更新时调用，包括字段挂载、卸载、值变更、blur、校验状态与错误信息变更，参数为 formState。
onChange.en-US: Called when the form state changes: a field mounts, unmounts, changes its value, blurs, or changes its validation state or error. Receives formState.

onErrorChange.zh-CN: 校验状态更新时调用，参数为全部错误和本次变化的字段错误。validate、submit、reset 等批量操作只调用一次，静默校验不调用。
onErrorChange.en-US: Called when validation state changes, with all errors and the errors that changed. Batch operations such as validate, submit and reset call it once; silent validation does not.

onReset.zh-CN: 点击重置按钮或调用 formApi.reset 时调用。
onReset.en-US: Called when a reset button is clicked or formApi.reset is called.

onSubmit.zh-CN: 点击提交按钮或调用 formApi.submitForm 且校验通过后调用，参数为 values 与提交事件；配置了 `schema` 时 values 是 schema 的输出。
onSubmit.en-US: Called when a submit button is clicked or formApi.submitForm is called and validation passes, with values and the submit event. With `schema`, values are the schema's output.

onSubmitFail.zh-CN: 点击提交按钮或调用 formApi.submitForm 且校验失败后调用，参数为 errors、values 与提交事件。errors 的每个错误是字符串数组；校验函数抛出的异常原样传入。
onSubmitFail.en-US: Called when a submit button is clicked or formApi.submitForm is called and validation fails, with errors, values and the submit event. Each error in errors is a string array; an exception thrown by a validator is passed as is.

onValueChange.zh-CN: 字段的值变化时调用，参数为全部 values 与本次变化的字段值。
onValueChange.en-US: Called when a field value changes, with all values and the values that changed.

ref.zh-CN: 取得 form 元素的回调，元素上带有 formApi。
ref.en-US: Receives the form element, which carries the formApi.

schema.zh-CN: 实现了 Standard Schema 的校验对象（如 Zod、Valibot、ArkType），用于校验，并在实现了 Standard JSON Schema 时导出要渲染的 JSON Schema。校验全部字段通过后，`onSubmit` 拿到 schema 的输出。
schema.en-US: A Standard Schema object (Zod, Valibot, ArkType and so on) that validates the form and, when it implements Standard JSON Schema, gives the JSON Schema to render. Once all fields pass, `onSubmit` receives the schema's output.

schemaDebounce.zh-CN: 配置了 `schema` 时，值变化触发的校验在输入停顿多少毫秒后才运行；submit、formApi.validate 与 blur 触发的校验不等待。
schemaDebounce.en-US: With `schema`, how many milliseconds of pause in input a change-triggered validation waits for. Validation on submit, formApi.validate and blur does not wait.

showValidateIcon.zh-CN: 校验信息前是否显示对应状态的图标。
showValidateIcon.en-US: Whether the validation message is preceded by an icon of its status.

stopPropagation.zh-CN: 是否阻止 submit、reset 事件冒泡，用于嵌套 Form 时避免触发外层 Form 的事件。
stopPropagation.en-US: Whether to stop the submit and reset events from bubbling, so that a nested Form does not trigger the events of the outer one.

stopValidateWithError.zh-CN: 使用 rules 校验时，遇到第一条不通过的规则后是否不再校验后续规则。字段上的同名属性优先。
stopValidateWithError.en-US: Whether to skip the remaining rules after the first rule fails. The same property on a field takes precedence.

trigger.zh-CN: 统一应用在每个字段上的校验时机，可选 change、blur、mount、custom 或其数组。字段上的同名属性优先。
trigger.en-US: When every field validates: change, blur, mount, custom, or an array of them. The same property on a field takes precedence.

validator.zh-CN: Form 级别的校验函数，与 `schema` 互斥，用法同 Form 的 validator。
validator.en-US: Form-level validation, exclusive with `schema`; works as the validator of Form.

wrapperCol.zh-CN: 统一应用在每个字段上的控件栅格布局，同 Col 的 span、offset 等属性，需与 labelCol 一起设置。
wrapperCol.en-US: Grid layout of the control of every field, with the properties of Col such as span and offset. Set it together with labelCol.

jsonSchema.zh-CN: 要渲染的 JSON Schema，优先于从 `schema` 导出的 JSON Schema。
jsonSchema.en-US: The JSON Schema to render. It takes precedence over the JSON Schema exported from `schema`.
